start: Menu row "Set up your gym" (address /setup), a new gym, signed in as owner

steps.action: Open "Set up your gym"
user_sees: Title "Set up your gym", under it "Finish these steps and your gym is ready for members."; a ring with "{done} of {total} steps done"; each step with "Open" or the word "done"
must_not: A step shown done that was never done; a total that differs from the number of rows

steps.action: Tap "Open" on a step, for example adding plans
user_sees: That step's own page, with a bar that offers "Next step" and "Back to the list"
must_not: The bar missing, so the owner is lost on the step's page

steps.action: Do the step (add a plan), tap "Back to the list"
user_sees: The step now says "done" by itself; the ring and the count go up by one; the menu row shows the same count
must_not: The step still open after the work is done; the menu row and the page disagreeing

steps.action: On a step that the app cannot check by itself, tap "Mark done"
user_sees: That step says "done"; the ring goes up
must_not: "Mark done" offered on a step the app can check by itself

steps.action: Finish every step
user_sees: "All done. Your gym is ready for members."; the menu row loses its ring and sits under "Your gym"
must_not: The row vanishing so the page cannot be found again

start: Other ways in: phone "More", the old address /get-started, and the step "Let people join your gym online" (address /setup/online)

steps.action: On a phone tap "More"
user_sees: "Set up your gym" as the top row while steps are left, with its ring and count and the hint "Finish these steps and your gym is ready for members."
must_not: The row missing on a phone

steps.action: Type the old address /get-started
user_sees: The same page at /setup
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: Open /setup/online
user_sees: The step's own page: the join link, the QR poster and how people pay, in one place
must_not: The step ticked just by opening it

steps.action: From a step's page tap "Next step" until the last one
user_sees: Each next step in order; on the last: "This is the last step on the list."
must_not: "Next step" looping back to the first step

start: Nothing to type here: what the owner sees when a step is not really done, and what a front-desk login sees

steps.action: Open a step, do nothing, come back
user_sees: The step is still open; the count unchanged
must_not: A step ticked just because its page was opened

steps.action: Use a browser that cannot keep data (private window), tap "Mark done", reload
user_sees: The tick may be gone after the reload; the page still opens
must_not: A crash or a blank page because the tick could not be kept

steps.action: Sign in as front desk and type /setup
user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Back to Today"; no "Set up your gym" row in the desk's menu
must_not: The owner's to-do list shown to the desk

start: A hand-ticked step and the page's place in the menu, over time

steps.action: Tap "Mark done" on a hand-ticked step
user_sees: "done"; the ring goes up
must_not: A way to tick it twice

steps.action: Look for a way to un-tick it
user_sees: None was seen in the code read: a wrong tap stays
must_not: The count going above the total

steps.action: Tap "Move this page to the bottom of the menu"
user_sees: "You can still open it from Your gym in the menu."; the row leaves the top but keeps its ring and count
must_not: The page gone from the menu and from More

steps.action: Tap "Show this page at the top of the menu again"
user_sees: The row is back on top
must_not: Two rows for the same page

steps.action: A new step is added by an app update after all were done
user_sees: The count shows one left and the row has its ring again
